payload.title: One standard Papyrus front end for every Papyrus site
payload.description:
Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-20): pay off front-end debt early. Every Papyrus/Markus site renders through ONE standard front end in Papyrus core (StandardMarkusProjector configured by projection.json). Sites keep only theme (CSS + tokens), brand assets, nav/redirect data and a few named hooks. Core owns: RSS and Atom feeds, sitemap with lastmod, robots, 404, canonical/Open Graph/Twitter/JSON-LD, listings/pagination/tags, accessible components, staging guard, pattern redirects as data, calls to action and forms, consent analytics.

Pilots: Distinctive Mark (sections, custom content types, hooks) and Pilobol.us (no sections: the reference case for a publication without sections). Then the small product sites (Papyrus-web, Prospectus-web, Kanbus-web, Auritus-web, Apricity-web), docs sites, the framework marketing sites that embed Markus prose (Chatticus, Tactus, Cyclotron-web; shared header/footer component), then Threat Intelligence and the read.p.apyr.us reader (no static projection today), and Anth.us last in gated phases (production).

Parity per site: every published URL before/after (status, headers, normalised DOM, head metadata, sitemap URL set, redirects, feed validity), intentional differences allow-listed with reasons.

Also: unify Markus pins (fleet ranges from 0.5.1 to git SHAs; latest 0.13.0); live gaps found in the inventory (missing sitemaps/robots on most sites, p.apyr.us 403 on missing pages, pr.ospect.us canonical ending /index.html).
